description: Form-associated color picker with saturation/lightness area, hue slider, HEX/RGB/HSL/OKLCH inputs, preset swatches, Copy and EyeDropper

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name. A name on the inner input (the no-JS path) moves here on upgrade so exactly one value submits.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the trigger, closes the panel and drops the value from submission. A disabled ancestor fieldset has the same effect.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Initial input/copy format. The Format selector inside the panel switches it at runtime.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Reflected while the panel is open

structure.description: Supplies the initial value (its value attribute is the form-reset target) and the no-JS fallback. Its <label for> names the trigger.
Preset swatches — one <option value="#hex">Name</option> per swatch

childAttributes.name: name
childAttributes.description: Submission name for the no-JS fallback. Moved to the host on upgrade (the host's own name wins if both are set).

events.name: color-picker:change
events.detail: { hex, rgb: { r, g, b }, hsl: { h, s, l }, source: 'pointer' | 'keyboard' | 'api' | 'internal' }
events.description: Fired when the color changes. source is 'api' for .value assignments, 'pointer'/'keyboard' for the area and hue slider, 'internal' for text inputs, swatches and the EyeDropper.
